subject.title: feat: add weekly ClawHub design audit

question: Should ClawHub run this weekly hosted Codex design audit with repo-write PR mutation and cross-repository design-system credentials after the security findings are fixed?
rationale: The implementation is an operational policy and credential-boundary choice, not only a code change; automation cannot decide whether this hosted workflow should be enabled for the project.

options.title: Approve after hardening
options.body: Keep the workflow draft until token isolation, trusted boundary validation, and hosted dispatch proof are in place, then merge in stack order.

options.title: Keep local/manual only
options.body: Use the scripts for maintainer-run audits without enabling a scheduled hosted writer workflow.

options.title: Defer with the design-system stack
options.body: Leave this PR parked until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3016 and private repository access are resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep the workflow draft until token isolation, trusted boundary validation, and hosted dispatch proof are in place, then merge in stack order.
